content:
You choreograph drone swarms using motion primitives. Choose primitives that match the music;
respect timing, collision, and step limits. Coordinates are integer cm.

Plan a beat-by-beat choreography for 5 drones to "Crazyflie Drones Theme".
<song> beats: 20 beat_times_100ms: {1: 4, 2: 36, 3: 69, 4: 110, 5: 147, 6: 175, 7: 203, 8: 230, 9: 254, 10: 295, 11: 318, 12: 341, 13: 364, 14: 397, 15: 424, 16: 452, 17: 475, 18: 512, 19: 535, 20: 565} beat_intervals_100ms: {1: 4, 2: 32, 3: 33, 4: 41, 5: 37, 6: 28, 7: 28, 8: 28, 9: 23, 10: 41, 11: 23, 12: 23, 13: 23, 14: 33, 15: 28, 16: 28, 17: 23, 18: 37, 19: 23} amplitude_dbfs: {1: -25, 2: -31, 3: -33, 4: -25, 5: -26, 6: -25, 7: -26, 8: -18, 9: -17, 10: -17, 11: -18, 12: -18, 13: -16, 14: -17, 15: -17, 16: -27, 17: -29, 18: -12, 19: -12, 20: -36} novelty_pct: {1: 11, 2: 97, 3: 16, 4: 100, 5: 53, 6: 47, 7: 61, 8: 32, 9: 50, 10: 64, 11: 43, 12: 44, 13: 61, 14: 58, 15: 58, 16: 54, 17: 70, 18: 62, 19: 63, 20: 15} chords: {1: 'E', 2: 'E', 3: 'E', 4: 'E', 5: 'E', 6: 'A', 7: 'A', 8: 'E', 9: 'E', 10: 'A', 11: 'E', 12: 'E', 13: 'E', 14: 'A', 15: 'E', 16: 'C#m', 17: 'E', 18: 'A', 19: 'B', 20: 'E'} </song>
<drones> count: 5 start_cm: [[0, 0, 100], [70, 35, 100], [70, -35, 100], [-70, 35, 100], [-70, -35, 100]] max_step_cm_per_beat: {1: 43, 2: 319, 3: 327, 4: 411, 5: 367, 6: 277, 7: 275, 8: 277, 9: 231, 10: 413, 11: 229, 12: 229, 13: 229, 14: 325, 15: 275, 16: 277, 17: 229, 18: 367, 19: 231, 20: 297} bounds_cm: lower=[-120.  -70.   25.] upper=[120.  70. 170.] </drones>
<rules> - Exactly 20 beats (keys 1..20); one choreography line per beat; end with END. - No two drones share the same position at the same beat. - Respect max_step_cm_per_beat and bounds_cm; z > 0. - Tie motion to music: louder/novel beats -> bolder primitives; all drones move on loud+novel beats when possible. - Prefer symmetric formations and varied 3D motion (altitude changes, geometric shapes). - At most 4 multi-beat primitives per song; prefer spiral, helix, zig_zag, wave over trivial moves. - Use enough PLAN beats for readable motion: after a formation/rotate/height change, insert PLAN before the next different primitive unless beats are very scarce. - Multi-beat primitives are exclusive: a primitive with steps=S must be followed immediately by S-1 PLAN beats before any other primitive. - One beat = one line. Multiple calls on one beat: separate with "; " (e.g. center([1,2]); move_z([3], 10)). - Each drone touched at most once per beat (except separate move() per drone). </rules>
<primitives> Single-beat (usually followed by PLAN before switching primitive): - rotate(angle_deg, axis) — all drones; axis usually 'z' - center([ids]) — listed drones to formation around their centroid - move_z([ids], delta_cm) — vertical shift - form_circle([ids], height_cm) — circle at height; radius from count - form_star(height_cm, spacing 40-80, delta_radius 50-100) - form_cone(delta_height 30-80, spacing 40-80, is_inverted 0|1) - swap(id1, id2) — swap two drones (only one swap pair per beat) - move(x_cm, y_cm, z_cm, drone_id) — absolute position for one drone
Multi-beat (steps in [2,3]; follow immediately with steps-1 PLAN lines; start by beat s-steps+1 so it finishes before END): - spiral(steps, height_cm) - spiral_speed(steps, height_cm, angle_deg 0-360, radius_increase 1-3) - helix(steps, delta_h_cm 0-100, height_cm 50-100) - twister(steps, omega_x10 2-20, z_spacing_cm 5-30) - zig_zag(steps, delta_xy_cm, delta_z_cm) - wave(steps, height, mu_pairs, a_coeffs, b_coeffs) — 2D wave surface; equation: The disturbance \(u(s, t)\) at any point \(s = (s_1, s_2) \in [0, a] \times [0, b]\) 
at time \(t\) is governed by:
\[
c^2 \nabla^2 u(s, t) = \frac{\partial^2 u(s, t)}{\partial t^2},
\]
where \( \nabla^2 \) is the spatial Laplacian and \(c > 0\) is the wave speed. 
The solution:
\[
u(s, t) = \sum_{(\mu_1, \mu_2)} a_{\mu_1 \mu_2} \sin \left( \frac{\mu_1 \pi s_1}{a} \right) 
\sin \left( \frac{\mu_2 pi s_2}{b} \right) \sin(\omega_{\mu_1 \mu_2} t) 
+ b_{\mu_1 \mu_2} \sin \left( \frac{\mu_1 \pi s_1}{a} \right) 
\sin \left( \frac{\mu_2 \pi s_2}{b} \right) \cos(\omega_{\mu_1 \mu_2} t),
\]

with frequencies:

\[
\omega_{\mu_1 \mu_2}^2 = c^2 \pi^2 \left( \frac{\mu_1^2}{a^2} + \frac{\mu_2^2}{b^2} \right).
\]
PLAN — hold positions for one beat, add breathing room, and fill multi-beat tails. Never end the song on a multi-beat primitive without trailing PLANs. </primitives>
<process> 1) song_mood — brief mood for "Crazyflie Drones Theme". 2) cord_analysis — chords, major/minor, emotional effect. 3) choreography_plan — sections, primitives, and why; scale intensity to dbfs/novelty/intervals. 4) choreography — full beat list 1..20, no "..." placeholders. </process>

<example>
Input: song=rêverie, drones=3, beats=22 (quiet dbfs ~-50..-30; novelty peak ~98 at beat 6).
Output:
song_mood: Dreamy, contemplative Debussy; gentle fluid motion.
cord_analysis: Cm, A#m, F, Gm mix — wistful, not dramatic.
choreography_plan: Beats 1-5: slow spiral inward (low novelty). Beat 6+: rotate and move_z on peak. Mid song: second spiral + zig_zag. Use PLAN between primitive changes; keep steps small for quiet dynamics.
choreography:
  1: spiral(5, 100)
  2: PLAN
  3: PLAN
  4: PLAN
  5: PLAN
  6: PLAN
  7: rotate(60, 'z')
  8: PLAN
  9: rotate(-90, 'z')
  10: PLAN
  11: move_z([1, 2, 3], 30)
  12: PLAN
  13: spiral(4, 100)
  14: PLAN
  15: PLAN
  16: PLAN
  17: PLAN
  18: zig_zag(5, 20, 20)
  19: PLAN
  20: PLAN
  21: PLAN
  22: PLAN
  END
</example>

song_mood: "Energetic and dynamic with a playful, adventurous feel."
cord_analysis: "E major with transitions to A and C#m; bright and uplifting with moments of tension."
choreography_plan: "Start with a spiral to match the energetic opening. Use form_circle and form_star for symmetry on loud beats. Incorporate zig_zag and wave for dynamic motion. Use PLAN for transitions and to maintain clarity."
choreography:
  1: spiral(3, 100)
  2: PLAN
  3: PLAN
  4: form_circle([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 50)
  5: PLAN
  6: zig_zag(2, 30, 20)
  7: PLAN
  8: form_star(100, 60, 80)
  9: PLAN
  10: wave(2, 80, [[0, 0], [1, 0]], [0.5, 0.25], [0.2, 0.1])
  11: PLAN
  12: form_cone(60, 60, 0)
  13: PLAN
  14: rotate(90, 'z')
  15: PLAN
  16: helix(3, 50, 100)
  17: PLAN
  18: PLAN
  19: form_circle([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 70)
  20: PLAN
  END
